name: deepgram
label: Deepgram
description: Deepgram is an AI-powered speech recognition platform that provides real-time transcription, text-to-speech, and audio analysis capabilities.

token.label: API Key
token.description: You can obtain your API key from [Deepgram Console](https://console.deepgram.com/).

get_request.label: Get Request
get_request.description: Gets one past Deepgram request by ID with its status, duration and cost.

project.label: Project
project.description: The Deepgram project to use. Leave empty when your API key belongs to a single project.

requestId.label: Request ID
requestId.description: The request ID returned by a Deepgram action, for example Create Transcription (Callback).

deepgram_get_request.label: Get Request (Agent)
deepgram_get_request.description: Gets one past Deepgram request by ID with its status, duration and cost.

project_id.label: Project ID
project_id.description: The Deepgram project ID, from List Projects (list_projects). Leave empty when the API key belongs to a single project.

requestId.label: Request ID
requestId.description: The request ID returned by a Deepgram action, for example Create Transcription (Callback).
